items.problem: The error row "`capture_screen` failure" has no condition anywhere in the spec, and line 86 waits for a drawn frame with no limit. skills/client-core/modules/qa-core.md:58 and skills/client-core/engines/godot.md:395 name a state in which the engine does not draw the window (a window fully covered by other windows) and handle it for `QACore` by drawing one frame (`RenderingServer.force_draw()` after 2 process frames). For `NativeUiCore`, one implementation never returns in that state, so a content flow that awaits `capture_screen` before `share` stops; another forces a draw and returns PNG bytes; another returns empty bytes with an error log. The three give different results to the caller
